verdict.rationale: LobeChat/LobeHub explicitly documents plugging in MCP servers: a marketplace of 100k+ MCP servers to discover and add, desktop install of local MCP connectors, and a guided wizard to connect local agents/connectors, all to power tools usable by Agents. This is first-party documentation with a dedicated MCP marketplace page and connector features, though there's no independent hands-on report confirming reliability. Missing for 10: independent/third-party verification of actual tool invocation working end-to-end, and edge-case reliability reports.
